name: アイコンタクト一貫性解析
algorithm: Eye Contact Consistency — ピクセルレベル空間分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes eye contact patterns for deepfake detection:

1. **視線Direction推定**: Per-frame gaze direction is estimated from iris position, eye corner landmarks, and head pose. The gaze vector is decomposed into horizontal and vertical components relative to the camera, determining whether the subject appears to be making eye contact.

2. **目Contactパターン分析**: Natural eye contact follows specific behavioral patterns — during conversation, humans alternate between direct eye contact and glancing away (typically maintaining eye contact 60-70% of time). The method models these patterns and checks whether the subject's gaze behavior follows expected psychological norms.

3. **視線-HeadCoordination**: When shifting gaze, natural eye movements combine eye rotation (saccades) with head rotation in coordinated vestibulo-ocular patterns. The method verifies gaze-head coordination — deepfakes may produce eye movements decoupled from head motion or show unnaturally stable gaze during head turns.

4. **Bilateral視線一貫性**: Both eyes should converge on the same target point (vergence). The method checks that left and right eye gaze vectors intersect at a plausible depth. Deepfakes may produce strabismus-like artifacts where eyes appear to look in slightly different directions.

5. **時間的視線Naturalness**: Gaze changes include saccades (fast, ballistic movements), smooth pursuit (tracking moving objects), and fixations (stable gaze). The method analyzes the temporal structure of gaze signals for correct velocity profiles. AI-generated eye movements often lack natural saccadic dynamics, producing either unrealistically smooth or jittery gaze patterns.
parameters:
分析タイプ: ピクセル
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through eye contact consistency analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
